Office move plan (Example Widgets Inc., synthetic)
The Riverside office (180 staff) moves to the Hill Street building on 6 October. Movers pack on Friday 3 October from 14:00. Staff work from home on Monday 6 October while IT sets up desks. Parking: 60 spaces instead of 90; a shuttle runs from the train station every 15 minutes at peak times. Hot-desking replaces assigned desks for teams that are in the office fewer than 3 days a week.

tabs.indepth:
In depth
Riverside moves to Hill Street on 6 October
All 180 Riverside staff move to the Hill Street building. Movers start packing on Friday 3 October at 14:00, and everyone works from home on Monday 6 October while IT sets up desks.
Getting there
Parking falls from 90 to 60 spaces, so a shuttle will run from the train station every 15 minutes at peak times.
[Chart] Parking spaces
Category | Spaces
Riverside | 90
Hill Street | 60
Desks
Teams in the office fewer than 3 days a week will use hot-desking.
[Glossary] hot-desking: Nobody has a fixed desk; you take any free desk when you come in.

tabs.eli5:
ELI5
The big idea: the office is moving, and you should stay home on moving day
On 6 October the whole office moves to a new building. On that Monday, everyone works from home.
Parking and desks
There are fewer parking spots, but a little bus runs from the train station. Some teams will share desks, taking any free one, like picking a seat on a bus.
Think of it like
Moving house: pack on Friday, and do not visit while the boxes are being unpacked.

notes: Solid and accurate; chart is correct but adds little (D5=3); ELI5 simplifies and stays true.
